instruction: Candid documentary photograph, medium shot. In an outdoor backyard with trees and hanging string lights, three friends interact. On the left, the man in the patterned beige t-shirt and pink bandana (R3) in profile extends his fist to bump the hand of the woman in the pink button-down shirt (R1), who stands on the right in profile. In the center, the woman in the white crochet vest and colorful headband (R2) stands facing forward, looking down at their hands. The lighting is soft and natural, with a shallow depth of field blurring the green trees and warm string lights in the background.
elements: R3 extends his fist toward R1's hand for a fist bump
R1 is the contact partner whose hand is being bumped by R3's extended fist
R2 looks down at R1 and R3's hands instead of joining the fist-bump contact
R1 and R3 form the hand-contact pair while R2 observes
The interaction occurs in an outdoor backyard with trees and hanging string lights
